name: Our Souls
overview: Scripture reveals that the soul is the essential life given by God, as seen in Genesis 2:7 where man became a living soul through God's breath. The soul belongs to God and carries moral responsibility, for the soul that sins shall die (Ezekiel 18:4, 20). While the body can be killed, the soul's ultimate destiny is under God's authority, who can destroy both body and soul in hell (Matthew 10:28). The New Testament also shows the soul as the recipient of salvation, with thousands added to the number of souls through faith and baptism (Acts 2:41).
